column1: # DISPLAY-NAME ALIASES (user idea 2026-11-19): the effect template + the spell animation stay, only the name the player reads changes, so a pet never shows a name that does not fit it.

# columns (TAB): spell name (as the fit picked it) | creature-name regex that KEEPS the original name (empty = never keep) | effect-label regex (empty = any effect) | new display name | new icon (empty = keep the spell's icon)
# first matching row wins; generated by hand from pet-battle/name_audit.tsv review

# 2026-11-21 PREY / CRITTER NAMES (user approved the approach): a name must fit the REAL spell's animation (pet-battle/spell_anim_tags.tsv), the slot's effect and the species. Cols: spell | keep | effect-label regex | new name | icon | family regex | creature-name regex. First match wins (these rows come first).
# 2026-11-21 identified from wow pet sites: Mr. Wiggles + Lucky = pigs (Children's Week collar / Fortune Coin), Wolpertinger = horned hare (Brewfest), Wisp = Magic wisp
# 2026-11-21 ANIMAL-ONLY renames (8th column creature types 1,2,8): person-class names on animals. Holy Fire fallback = Lunar Flare (user)
# 2026-11-21 fish (Aquatic family + fish names) and Mechanical family renames (user approved)
# a heal that ALSO buffs (retail heal + damage/crit rider) must not wear the name of a pure heal: the effect names the ability, the spell only lends the animation
# 2026-11-21 name audit: hunter-pet names on pets they do not fit. 6th column = only for these families (display name + icon only; effect and animation unchanged)
